name: Yue Yu
research_summary: Yu develops efficient optimization and control algorithms for autonomous aerospace systems. His work includes planning paths in real time and coordinating multiple vehicles using game theory, with applications to advanced air mobility and spacecraft control.

quiz.question: What type of aerospace systems does Yu study?
Does his work include real-time planning?
choices: No, only plans made a year in advance.

quiz.question: What theory helps coordinate multiple vehicles?
Name one application.
choices: Advanced air mobility or spacecraft control.
quiz.answer: Advanced air mobility or spacecraft control.
